title: H230: Alpha Decay Optimization for H217/H228 Rebalancing Frequency
rationale: arXiv:2512.11913 (Dec 2025) models alpha decay using a hyperbolic decay function across Fama-French factors (1963-2024). Key finding: momentum exhibits sharp alpha decay after formation (drops ~40% in the first 3 months OOS), while quality/low-vol factors decay more slowly. Our confirmed signals: H217 (alpha101 median, monthly) and H228 (alpha101+reversal blend) are currently rebalanced monthly. If the alpha101 signal decays within the month, bi-monthly or tri-monthly rebalancing might improve Sharpe while reducing transaction costs. H230 would test whether (a) weekly or (b) every-2-week rebalancing of H217 OOS Sharpe improves from 1.559 — modeling the decay curve empirically from our H217 IS data, then testing the optimal rebalancing frequency OOS. Confirm: any frequency beats H217 monthly Sharpe 1.559 with transaction costs included (assume 0.1% round-trip per rebalance).
